topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I can't believe it. Of all the cities in the world, it had to be this one. We talked for months, shared everything, and now I find out he lives just a few blocks away. I’ve been walking by his place for who knows how long, and we’ve been chatting like we’re continents apart. What are the odds? I don’t even know what to say to him now. The coffee shop meet-up seemed like a good idea at the time, but now? I’m not sure I can go through with it. It’s all just... a lot.
